notes: INSIDE half of the Emberkin Cinder Mortar: a coal hopper that fills with glowing cinders as it charges (frame 5 = heaped and white-hot, strip yellow) above a firing pan, power coupling, brass hatch. fire: the pan flashes and the hopper empties (a flashback puff at the hatch). damaged: the hopper cracked, embers falling out, lamps dead; disabled: cold ash, the hopper split. Barrel layer emberkin_cinder_mortar_barrel: a short fat brass mortar with a wide funnel mouth full of embers.
